temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn was normally engaging and had no specific knowledge that Marilyn was struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns Marilyn's quietness is due to being overwhelmed rather than simple moodiness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is dealing with significant work and personal stress and may need support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to offer support and stay available if Marilyn wants to talk

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn was curt in a later interaction; after Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After her earlier check-in, Carolyn believed she might have overstepped because Marilyn was curt, leaving Carolyn confused and slightly hurt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns Marilyn's curtness was due to a hard week and not a personal rejection, and that her attempt to clear the misunderstanding was received well.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn appreciates her support and is not upset with her; the misunderstanding is eased.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: confused and hurt initially, then relieved and comforted
temporal_state_chain.intention: to continue showing support while being mindful of Marilyn's boundaries

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend gathering; Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, Carolyn believed their friendship was developing and felt hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns Marilyn is willing to socialize outside work, confirming reciprocal interest in the friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes their friendship is growing and Marilyn wants to spend time together.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to host the gathering and strengthen the bond with Marilyn

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Marilyn still seems professionally distant at the bank; when Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she did not realize, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed their outside-work friendship was growing and hoped that closeness would carry into their work relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns the distance may be unintentional or a boundary issue, and Marilyn is open to addressing it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes there is a work-dynamic issue to resolve, but Marilyn is willing to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: disappointed, then cautiously hopeful and reassured
temporal_state_chain.intention: to have a direct conversation about their work dynamic and clarify professional expectations and boundaries

temporal_state_chain.observed: Carolyn proposes teaming up on a new project; Marilyn says it is a great idea, is glad they talked, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their private meeting, Carolyn believed they had cleared the air and now understood each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn's belief that their partnership improved is confirmed by Marilyn's enthusiasm and agreement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they can collaborate effectively and that their partnership is stronger while respecting boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.intention: to team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership
